name: Kaname
source:
A 20-year-old bassist (alumnus) belonging to a light music club on the verge of being disbanded.
Although he has already graduated from school, he wears a school uniform and pretends to be a student in order to enter and exit the club room.
He is Hiroki's childhood friend.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01633087.html]DLsite[/url]]
